response.sql: WITH event_rates AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type, AVG(b.spent / b.amount) as event_spending_rate FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_spending_rate) as type_avg_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) as overall_avg FROM type_rates) SELECT t.type, t.type_avg_rate, t.type_avg_rate / o.overall_avg as rate_divided_by_mean FROM type_rates t CROSS JOIN overall_mean o

assumptions.assumption: budget.amount > 0 for all budget lines to avoid division by zero

alternatives.interpretation: If 'average spending rate' for each event means the overall spending ratio (total spent ÷ total budgeted amount) rather than the arithmetic mean of per-line spending rates, use SUM(b.spent) / SUM(b.amount) instead of AVG(b.spent / b.amount).
